positioning: Quiet Luxury — אופנת נשים יוקרתית, אלגנטית, על-זמנית

visual_dna.contrast: medium-low, lifted blacks, no crushed shadows
visual_dna.saturation: slightly desaturated except the dress itself

framing_rules: full-length or three-quarter body, dress fully visible
model face may be turned away, cropped, or softly out of focus — the dress is the subject
generous negative space above the head and below the hem
eye-level or very slightly low camera angle
shot as if on 85mm f/2.0 — shallow but not blurry background

backgrounds.prompt: a sunlit travertine stone wall in a quiet Mediterranean courtyard, warm ivory tones, soft diagonal afternoon shadow falling across the stone
a seamless hand-troweled lime plaster studio backdrop in warm bone white, subtle texture, single large soft key light from camera left
the quiet corner of a boutique hotel lobby, brushed brass detailing, deep walnut panelling far out of focus, warm low ambient light
a pale limestone beach at golden hour, calm sea far in the background heavily out of focus, soft warm rim light
a stone terrace with an old olive tree, dappled late-afternoon light, dusty sage and sand tones
a whitewashed arched corridor in a Mediterranean villa, deep shadow on one side, bright bounced daylight on the other
sheer linen curtains moving in warm window light against a bone-white wall, gentle backlight
a wide pale marble staircase with a slim brass handrail, cool diffused daylight from a tall window above
a narrow European balcony at blue hour, warm interior light spilling from behind, city softly out of focus
smooth wind-shaped sand dunes under soft overcast light, monochrome warm sand palette, minimal horizon
a minimal art gallery interior, large empty warm-white wall, polished concrete floor, even museum lighting
a walled garden at night lit by warm lanterns, cypress silhouettes deep out of focus, soft pools of amber light

fidelity_rules: The dress must remain EXACTLY as in the source photograph.
Do not change: colour, hue, saturation, fabric, texture, sheen, print, pattern, sequins, lace, embroidery.
Do not change: silhouette, length, hemline, neckline, straps, sleeves, slit, back detail, corset boning, ruching, draping, seams.
Do not add, remove, lengthen or shorten any part of the garment.
Do not restyle, do not add jewellery, belts, bags or outerwear that were not in the source.
Only the background, the environment, the lighting on the scene and the overall colour grade may change.
negative_rules: no visible logos, no text, no watermarks, no captions burned into the image
no distorted hands, fingers, arms or facial features
no extra limbs, no duplicated body parts
no plastic or waxy skin, no heavy beauty retouching
no HDR halos, no oversharpening, no vignette
no cartoon, illustration, 3D render or CGI look
no busy or cluttered background, no other people in frame
